standard.summary: 启用动态显存自动保护。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 启用动态显存自动保护。仅在显存波动、偶发 OOM、或后台抢显存时建议开启；能稳定训练就可关闭以减少额外干预

advanced_en.principle: Enables dynamic VRAM auto-protection. Only recommended when VRAM fluctuates, OOMs are sporadic, or background processes grab VRAM; if training is stable, keep it off to reduce extra intervention.
